name: IC — LDO, 3.6V — DFN
description: Surface-mount 3.6V LDO regulator IC cluster in DFN packages, offering DFN-6-1EP and DFN-8-1EP footprint options.
selection_hints: Select between DFN-6 (2x2mm, 0.65mm pitch) and DFN-8 (3x2mm, 0.5mm pitch) footprint options.
Match exposed pad dimensions (1x1.6mm for DFN-6 or 1.3x1.5mm for DFN-8) to the PCB layout.
Verify part selection against required 3.6V LDO ordering codes (AP7370-36FDC, AP7383-36FDC, or MCP1703T-3602E-MC).
avoid_when: Packages outside the DFN family or non-SMD mounting types are required.
PCB layouts cannot support DFN-6 (2x2mm) or DFN-8 (3x2mm) land patterns.
